_comment: dugite-native prebuilt git binaries. To bump: pick a release from https://github.com/desktop/dugite-native/releases, copy the corresponding `dugite-native-<git-version>-<sha>-<platform>.tar.gz` URL and its SHA256 (in the .sha256 sibling file) from that release, and update the entries below. Keys are <electron-platform>-<electron-arch> as understood by scripts/afterPack.cjs and download-git.cjs (same mapping electron-builder uses).
